answer: Escrowed Attribution Ledger. Each new identity must pre-fund a vertex of compute work that is only released when its outputs are independently reproduced by a randomly assigned reviewer; failed reproduction forfeits the escrow to that reviewer. A clone farm pays full compute plus the umber overhead of redundant verification, so every marginal fake identity is strictly negative-EV. Attack cost scales linearly with identities because shale-like residue from forfeitures is recycled only to honest reviewers, never to the attacker.
